## Abliterated Large Flash API

Abliterated Large Flash is a large language model by Abliteration AI, available on the Venice API as `abliteration-abliterated-model-large-flash`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

Abliterated Large Flash is Abliteration AI's unrestricted multimodal model, based on DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and further abliterated. It has 552B backbone parameters (8B active on input, 16B on output) and a 1M-token context window. It natively processes images and text, with strong reasoning, coding, and agentic performance and no content-filtering guardrails.

### Abliterated Large Flash API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `abliteration-abliterated-model-large-flash` | Standard | Anonymized | $1.25 / $2.50 per 1M |

### Abliterated Large Flash specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Abliteration AI |
| Released | Oct 23, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Open weights | Yes |
| Context window | 1M tokens |
| Max output | 128K tokens |
| Reasoning effort | Not adjustable |
| Served precision | FP8 |

### How to use the Abliterated Large Flash API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "abliteration-abliterated-model-large-flash"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "abliteration-abliterated-model-large-flash",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }]
  }'
```
